purpose: Seed backlog for automatic dispatch so humans do not refill Muse/Google windows manually.

tasks.objective: Identify the single canonical scheduling authority and list competing schedulers/adapters that must not dispatch independently.
tasks.acceptance: One evidence-backed authority map with exact files/functions and no source changes.

tasks.objective: Connect canonical queue/continuation state to worker dispatch without creating a second scheduler.
tasks.acceptance: One queued task can be dispatched by the canonical authority and records durable dispatch identity.

tasks.objective: Prove the least-interactive supported Muse invocation path suitable for programmatic task delivery; do not spawn uncontrolled workers.
tasks.acceptance: Documented command/API capability and bounded no-side-effect probe.

tasks.objective: Implement or complete the Muse worker adapter behind the existing provider-neutral worker boundary.
tasks.acceptance: start/status/result/cancel/health path exists with stable worker_execution_id and targeted tests.

tasks.objective: Add deterministic logical slot states READY/CLAIMING/RUNNING/RESULT_READY/BLOCKED/RATE_LIMITED/IDLE_WAIT/AMBIGUOUS.
tasks.acceptance: State transitions are persisted and restart-safe.

tasks.objective: Classify provider quota/rate-limit as RATE_LIMITED with backoff and no aggressive retry or account rotation.
tasks.acceptance: Rate-limited slot releases schedulable work safely and resumes only after eligibility.

tasks.objective: Make VERIFIED/CLOSED task release its scope and automatically claim the next compatible task.
tasks.acceptance: Task A verified -> Task B starts without human relay.

tasks.objective: Prove RESULT_READY or completed result is never re-executed after retry/restart; resend same durable result instead.
tasks.acceptance: Repro/test covers duplicate delivery and restart.

tasks.objective: Prove ambiguous STARTED/IN_FLIGHT state does not blindly replay effects.
tasks.acceptance: Ambiguous execution moves to explicit uncertainty/block state with no duplicate effect.

tasks.objective: Ensure every spawned worker process has durable ownership metadata including task/attempt/worker/machine/process identity.
tasks.acceptance: No unowned worker process in canary path.

tasks.objective: Verify STOP/cleanup only terminates owned process trees and unrelated processes survive.
tasks.acceptance: Bounded integration test passes on target host without broad kill.

tasks.objective: Keep Mac new heavy admissions at max 1 initially; fail closed when resource/thermal state is UNKNOWN.
tasks.acceptance: Synthetic state tests prove admission rules; no stress test.

tasks.objective: Implement evidence-based Windows admission starting at max 2 heavy tasks independently of Mac.
tasks.acceptance: Windows state tests prove independent host limits and fail-closed UNKNOWN.

tasks.objective: Represent 64 logical slots without launching 64 heavy processes.
tasks.acceptance: 32 MAC + 32 WIN logical slots register with zero task load and near-idle control-plane cost.

tasks.objective: Register two hosts with host affinity/capability metadata so Mac and Windows do not claim incompatible work.
tasks.acceptance: Same queue routes host-specific tasks only to eligible host.

tasks.objective: Prove one global atomic claim across two hosts.
tasks.acceptance: Concurrent Mac/Windows claim test yields exactly one winner.

tasks.objective: Enforce at most one active writer per write_scope while allowing compatible read-only work.
tasks.acceptance: Conflicting writer is not dispatched; read-only task remains eligible.

tasks.objective: Create deterministic attempt-scoped worktree lifecycle for writer tasks.
tasks.acceptance: Writer effects are isolated and bound to exact attempt/base SHA.

tasks.objective: Collect structured worker results centrally and reconcile them to task/attempt/worker identity.
tasks.acceptance: Result cannot be attached to wrong attempt and survives supervisor restart.

tasks.objective: Deduplicate equivalent task candidates before dispatch and preserve provenance.
tasks.acceptance: Duplicate candidates collapse to one dispatchable logical task without deleting evidence.

tasks.objective: Prove 1000 queued tasks do not create 1000 model/process instances.
tasks.acceptance: Queue contains 1000 synthetic tasks while active process count remains bounded by admission limits.

tasks.objective: Provide one-command Mac worker bootstrap/registration using existing architecture.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh normal user shell can register host without opening 30 manual terminals.

tasks.objective: Provide one-command Windows worker bootstrap/registration using existing architecture.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh PowerShell can register host without manual per-window prompting.

tasks.objective: Add fail-closed host identity guard so Mac-only tasks cannot execute on Windows and vice versa.
tasks.acceptance: Wrong-host task returns WRONG_HOST before any source/process mutation.

tasks.objective: Productize known Antigravity IDE non-secret settings with backup + verifier; never store credentials or enable confirmations.
tasks.acceptance: Setup is idempotent, preserves unknown keys, and verifier reports expected policy.

tasks.objective: Make Wall a read-only status surface for logical slots, not a competing scheduler.
tasks.acceptance: Wall shows host/model/mode/task/scope/state/elapsed and aggregate counts from canonical state.

tasks.objective: Run bounded canary 1 -> 4 Muse workers with auto-next and no human relay.
tasks.acceptance: All results persisted, no duplicate execution, no scope collision, resource gate respected.

tasks.objective: Prove controlled supervisor/worker restart recovers durable state without lost result or duplicate execution.
tasks.acceptance: Exact task/attempt identity survives restart and terminal state is correct.

tasks.objective: Verify idle logical slots do not busy-poll or keep unnecessary model processes alive.
tasks.acceptance: Idle control plane uses bounded backoff/event waiting and process count remains minimal.

tasks.objective: Reconcile final evidence for queue->claim->worker->result->verify->next across two hosts and identify only real remaining blockers.
tasks.acceptance: Evidence matrix with PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN per invariant; no architecture rewrite and no unsourced success.
